figures.caption: Fig. 3. The three confidence signals. S1 is the model’s own certainty from token probabilities or self-consistency; S2 is the embedding similarity between the answer and the evidence; S3 is the variance of the reranker scores, used as a reward for clean separation.

Fig. 1. Fixed-depth RAG applies the same retrieval budget to every query, which over-retrieves for easy questions and under-retrieves for hard ones. AB-RAG estimates confidence after each answer and retrieves more only when needed, subject to a budget.

Fig. 4. A real worked example of the adaptive loop. The first round is below the threshold and triggers more retrieval; the second round crosses the threshold and the loop stops with the correct answer. The confidence values are taken from the actual run.

Fig. 6. Open-retrieval recall by method on HotpotQA and TriviaQA. The dense retriever is strongest on both datasets, hybrid fusion sits below it on this clean text, and reranking lifts the hard low-k recall.

Fig. 7. Exact Match for static RAG and AB-RAG across backbones, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals on the AB-RAG values. AB-RAG improves over static most clearly on the mid-sized model and on the closed model with TriviaQA.

Fig. 10. Single-signal predictiveness across backbones. S1, the model-certainty signal, is strongly predictive everywhere; S2, evidence consistency, is at or below chance for these short answers; S3, the corrected retrieval-variance reward, is weakly predictive.
Fig. 5. The token-probability and retrieval-variance confidence signals as implemented. The variance signal normalises the reranker scores before measuring their spread.

Fig. 8. High-confidence answers achieve far higher Exact Match than low-confidence answers on every backbone and dataset. The closed model on TriviaQA shows the cleanest separation, 57.6% against zero, with a large low-confidence group.

Fig. 9. Cost-accuracy tradeoff as the confidence threshold is swept. The closed model on HotpotQA shows a rising curve, the closed model on TriviaQA holds accuracy while cost rises, and the small Qwen model stays flat.
